preconditions.description: The length of list s1 must be between 1 and 4999.
The length of list s2 must be between 1 and 4999.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(x) < 25 for x in s1)
preconditions.description: Each string in s1 must have a length between 5 and 24.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(x) < 25 for x in s2)
preconditions.description: Each string in s2 must have a length between 5 and 24.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of strings in s2 that are either a prefix or suffix of any string in s1.
